title: Correction: clarify pivot_table structure
description: When a pivot request omits index, columns, values, or aggregation, ask for the missing structural choices before planning.
planner_guidance: Ask for row field, column field, value field, and aggregation. Use the dataset profile column names in the question.

example.question: Should I use region as rows, category as columns, and sum amount as values?

rag_note: Pivot correction should turn ambiguous natural language into explicit workflow JSON fields.
